text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a non-review original research paper focused on assessing the mitigation potential and environmental impacts of bioenergy with carbon capture and storage (BECCS) in Great Britain. While the study involves spatially explicit analysis of land availability and biomass production on agricultural land, it does not primarily focus on land use land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation as a central research question. The paper does not implement multiple future LULC scenarios with quantitative accuracy metrics or produce mapped LULC projections. Instead, it uses existing land cover data and models bioenergy crop yields and GHG emissions under scenarios of land-use change for bioenergy production. Thus, it is a biomass/bioenergy/carbon study incorporating land use change analysis but without a primary LULC prediction modeling component meeting the inclusion criteria.)
